cancellation_summary: Customers receive a full refund for cancellations 48 hours before the booking. Cancellations, changes, or no-shows within 48 hours are charged in full. Operator cancellations get a full refund.
meeting_point: Goodland Boat Park, 750 Palm Point Dr., Goodland, FL 34140
group_size: 17 Individuals, infants must weigh 17 lbs or heavier
accessibility: Yes, please note there are 3 steps in and out of the boat from the dock.
description: Explore the wonders of the 10,000 Islands and Rookery Bay Reserve while discovering the diverse wildlife inhabiting this pristine ecosystem. Encounter playful dolphins and various bird species along the way. Our journey includes a stop at a secluded beach for shell hunting and to witness the breathtaking sunset that graces the Gulf Coast. With a maximum capacity of 17 guests, there’s plenty of room for everyone to enjoy this immersive experience.
what_is_included:
Shell Bags 
Bottled Water
Cooler with ice for guest use
what_is_not_included:
Gratuity for your captain and guide not included in price, so please don't forget to tip your crew!
Parking Pass at the park. Per Collier County Park rules, if you do not have a Collier County Beach Sticker on your vehicle you must purchase a $10 parking pass.
Snacks are not provided, but you're welcome to bring any food or drinks along with you.
Towels are not included
itinerary:
You will be contacted a few days in advance to discuss your start time for the tour as each day the sunsets at a different time. We will schedule your tour to start an hour and a half before the scheduled sunset as the captain will need to bring you in within 30 minutes or so of the sun setting.

When you arrive at the park, you will be instructed by a crew member where to park, how to get a parking pass, and where to wait for the tour. You will be waiting in the shaded pavilion area until called for your tour. If you are not approached or you do not hear your name called, please find a crew member in one of our company shirts, they say Florida Adventures and Rentals on them. Your group will be brought down to the dock and assisted to board the boat. Your captain will do a safety briefing and your tour will begin. Our Sunset ecotours travel all around the islands south of Marco Island and stop on one of the isolated islands for sunset. Your crew will provide you with interesting facts and information about the ecosystem, history, and wildlife you come across throughout the tour. As you are walking the beach looking for shells, your captain and guide will assist in finding shells or answer any questions you may have. Or sit back on the boat and relax while watching the sunset over the Gulf. The tour will start and end at the same park location. Please note tours may start a few minutes late or end a few minutes late depending on the amount of activity at the dock as this is a public boat ramp and dock.
highlights:
The Gulf Coast of Florida is famous for our spectacular sunset views each and every day! Now imagine you are viewing them with your family, loved one, or friends on an isolated island with no one around. Truly special moment and a memory to last a lifetime. 

You'll enjoy the beauty of the sunset from either a beach or from the boat floating on the water. Bring drinks and food to enjoy as your captain navigates you in and around the mangrove islands. 

You may even get the opportunity to see some of our local dolphin population and unique sea birds as they enjoy the end of the day. You won't want to put your camera away as you try to capture every breathtaking moment.
check_in_details:
Guests will need to sign our online waivers before check in. This can be found in the confirmation email. A text the day before or morning of the tour will be sent as a reminder of location and waivers. 

A crew member will be at the park waiting to check in all guests for the scheduled tour. Please look out for our shirts to know who to check in with. 
Once parked and checked in you will be instructed for a parking pass, where the bathroom is, and where to wait before the crew calls for their group. 

Please note that our company waits at the shaded pavilion ONLY for check in. You cannot go down to the docks or any other part of the park to find us. If you do not see our crew, call the office for information and assistance.
what_to_bring:
Please bring water! 
Shoes you do not mind getting wet, preferably water shoes, flip flops or sandals.
Sunscreen
Hat
Towel
Camera
Sun protective clothing
You are welcome to bring any other beverages, even 21+ drinks are allowed on board the vessels. 
Snacks, breakfast or lunch is welcome on board the vessel as well.
special_requirements:
Infants must weigh more than 17 lbs to be on board any of our boats per Coast Guard Regulations. If under that weight, they are not allowed on board. 

All minors must be accompanied by an adult.

Service animals and dogs are allowed on private tours, but must remain on a leash the entire time on the island beach. Owner is responsible for dog, captains and crew are not responsible for the dog.
restrictions:
Dogs and other animals considered pets are prohibited on the beaches or islands that we visit. Service animals only!

No restrictions, but please consult your doctor if you are pregnant or have medical care needs before booking the tour to ensure your safety. 

Please note that we do have a step stool to get in and out of the boat at the beach. Boat is parked directly on the beach, and it is about 1-3 steps, depending on tide, to get off the boat and back into the boat. A railing is available to help balance.
extras: Life Jackets are available on the vessel, but are not required to be worn for adults or children during the tour. Your captain and crew will happily assist in putting them on or having them out for you per your request.
disclaimers:
Please understand that weather can change at any given moment that could prevent the tour from starting or result in your tour ending early. Our crew is constantly watching the radars to ensure all guests safety, it is their call to bring guests in early due to bad weather conditions.

If you or your guests in your party are not being respectful to your captain, guide, or other guests, the captain and guide have the right to return your group back to the dock. NO REFUND will be processed. 

Wildlife sightings can be unpredictable. We never know what the dolphins, birds or other wildlife are doing at any given time of day, or where they are hanging out. As you cruise around the islands, your captain is driving to all the known favorite spots of the dolphins. Sometimes this can take a little bit of time, so please be patient and understanding that your captain and guide are doing their best!
faqs:
Is there a restroom on board the vessel?
No, once on board the boat, Mother Nature becomes the restroom. Do not worry, the park we meet you at has a public restroom to use before you trip. Keep in mind it does close at sunset, so it may not be available when brought back at the end of your tour.

What should we wear? Should we bring bathing suits?
Bathing suits are ideal, but outdoor comfortable wear is perfect! Guests are welcome to swim at the island beach. Just ensure you have comfortable shoes that can get wet to walk along the beaches. If a lot of shells, it can be uncomfortable to walk on.

Will we see dolphins?
Yes, your captain and guide will be looking for them on the way to and from the island, along with other wildlife you may come across. You will also get interesting facts about the species as well.
